definitions.full: H2245. chabab [ חָבַב ] verb love (Late Hebrew Pi`el id. ; Arabic be loved ; Ethiopic amore alicujus incendi Di; Aramaic kindle, be set on fire , , חַבֵּב love, embrace , חוּבָּא bosom ) — Qal Participle עַמִּים חֹבֵב אַף Deut 33:3 (Di reads עַמּוֺ , compare ᵐ5 ).
